newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 7.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Protesters plan landing on disputed islands.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Flotilla set for disputed islands.
Newly-found Taiwan Independence Party celebrates founding day.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Special trade zone may allow Taiwan-China business transactions in third currency.
Central Bank governor says easy credit no panacea for economic recovery.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Financial reform task force to start working next month.
Government resists shortening work week to five days.
